objective: Evaluate the complete frozen R1 v2 Entry x R2 horizon architecture across all four 2023/2024 development folds without repeating the 2024H1-only representative-selection path or selecting a single maximum in the census stage.

already_completed: all 60 Entry x 11 horizon combinations on 2024H1 in R2
R6 freeze and candidate-specific 2024H2 validation of five complete strategies
duplicate_research_boundary.new_information: the unchanged complete 660-combination surface on exact 2023H1, 2023H2 and 2024H2, with four-fold family and neighbouring-horizon robustness
duplicate_research_boundary.not_authorized: repeat 2024H1 ranking, reopen R4/R6 winners, or choose the largest cell

execution_contract.entry: accepted R1 signal; next M15 bar mid open
execution_contract.exit_price: M15 mid close at exit index
execution_contract.month_boundary: entry and exit must remain in same UTC month
execution_contract.path_extrema: entry bar through exit bar inclusive

stage_1_preflight.failure_action: STOP; do not calculate 2023 or 2024H2 census outcomes

stage_2_census.unlock_condition: stage-1 preflight result, protocol, evaluator, registry and memory update merged after Research CI and memory validation
required_cell_metrics: trades, default and severe net/PF by fold
positive and negative months by fold
total excluding best two UTC entry dates by fold
stage_2_census.cell_support_gate: at least 20 trades in every fold
cell_core_gate: default net positive and PF at least 1 in every fold
severe net positive and PF at least 1 in every fold
cell_full_gate: positive months at least 4 and negative months at most 2 in every fold
total excluding best two UTC entry dates positive in every fold
entry_neighbourhood_gate: one unchanged Entry definition has at least three contiguous horizons in the frozen ordered horizon list passing the cell core gate
at least one horizon in that contiguous run passes the cell full gate
family_region_gate: at least two distinct Entry definitions in the same family pass the entry neighbourhood gate
supported Entry definitions cover at least two distinct parameter definitions rather than duplicate signal ledgers
family median minimum-fold severe net across its core-pass cells is positive
family_region_ranking_if_multiple: number of Entry definitions passing the neighbourhood gate
median of each core-pass cell's minimum-fold severe net
median full-year severe net across four folds
stage_2_census.selection_boundary: A passing family region only authorizes a separate finite preregistration. It does not authorize a candidate, exact horizon, MT4 parity or 2025 access.

prohibited: no horizon additions, interpolation or refinement
no filtering to R4/R6 winners before census
no outcome-derived weights, subsets, thresholds or interactions
no relabeling of closed exact candidates as passed
no Family I, Family J or F05 local repair
